title: Icons
summary: Semantic Material Symbol wrapper with exact Loader tracking, accessible decorative or informative modes and token-owned geometry.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

icon.description: The Material Symbols name of the glyph (home, mail, star); only that glyph's subset of the icon font is requested.

filled.description: Draws the filled form of the glyph (the font's FILL axis at 1); off, the outline.

weight.description: The stroke weight on the font's wght axis, 100 to 700 in steps of 100; any other value draws 400.

size.description: The glyph's step, 1/4 to 7. Steps 1, 2, 3 and 4 are the icons of a size 1/3, 1/2, 1 and 2 button (16, 20, 24, 28 on a desktop; 16, 16, 20, 24 on a phone and in a compact region); 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 5, 6 and 7 are 12, 12, 14, 32, 36, 40 and one step smaller on a phone. Empty: the size the component around it gives (--sf-icon--font-size), otherwise the icon of a size-1 button (24, phone 20).

type.description: The icon font's style: outlined, the one family the Framework ships. rounded and sharp are former values until 2027-01-01 and draw outlined (their fonts were never shipped: they fell back to the old Material Icons font with a console warning).

grade.description: The font's GRAD axis, -50 to 200: a finer weight that does not change the glyph's width; 0 by default.

optical-size.description: The font's opsz axis, 20 to 48: the drawing tuned for that size in px; 24 by default.

label.description: The accessible name. Set: the icon is an image with this name (role img). Empty: the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

badge-count.description: A count on the icon (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon's accessible name («Почта, 3 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

badge-dot.description: A dot on the icon, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

badge-cap.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

badge-label.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

loaded.description: The exact subset that draws this glyph is in place; synchronized from the Loader, never an authoring switch

accessibility.focus: The icon is not interactive and never enters the tab order. Name the containing control instead.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-icon for a Material Symbol that must participate in the Framework Loader and token scale. Omit label when adjacent text or a named control already conveys the meaning; provide a concise label only for an informative standalone symbol.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not make the icon focusable or use it as a control
Do not label a decorative icon inside an already named control
Do not use loaded as an authoring switch
